name: 10335-codegen-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16. Not substitutable: the speculative flags require this checkpoint's own multi-token-prediction draft head.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, half of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM: 48 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query heads over 2 kv heads at head_dim 256, sparse MoE of 512 experts at top-10 plus a shared expert, max_position_embeddings 262144, vocab 151936; 80B parameters, ~3B active per token, ~160 GB bf16 weights, ~40 GB per rank at TP4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 160 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `huggingface` data over `openai/openai_humaneval` (split test, 164 rows), single turn. Each request is one HumanEval `prompt` column -- a Python function signature and docstring, roughly 60-300 tokens -- generating exactly 512 tokens under `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`. The 160-request bound is under the dataset's 164 rows so no prompt is served twice. Seed 10335.
purpose: A code-completion helper writing 512-token Python bodies from docstrings, one user at a time, on four GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang, `sglang serve` CLI form.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. An indented or nested block is DROPPED silently, which
# would start the engine without a mechanism this file claims to declare.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 4

# Pinned regime keys: `NEXTN` is normalised to EAGLE against the checkpoint's own draft head.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit heuristic, which derives a value per process from what
# happens to be free -- and a different pool is a different scheduler.
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Absent on purpose: host / port / served-model-name are supplied at launch; context-length,
# chunked-prefill-size, cuda-graph-*, attention-backend, dtype, page-size, max-running-requests and
# every enable-* are left at the release defaults.
